# Descriptions
@@ 1
Caster has a 75% chance of detecting a trap in the area of effect. The caster
can concentrate on a different area each round. There must be living plants or
animals in the area of effect or no information will be gained.
@@ 2
Caster can locate the closest natural source of running water, exposed
groundwater, etc. exceeding 1 gallon. He will learn the approximate size and
quality of source.
@@ 3
Allows caster to set a fire of 1' radius. Fire will burn as long as there is
fuel. A target in the 1' radius will take an 'A' Heat critical.
@@ 5
Caster learns location, type, and approximate quantity of edible food (e.g.,
dead animal matter, plants, etc.). The food source must exceed 1 pound.
@@ 6
Allows caster to purify a number of gallons of water equal to his level.
@@ 7
Caster learns location, type, and approximate size of any waterproof, covered
space exceeding 125 cubic feet. The shelter must have an entry (exceeding 2'
radius) opening onto open air.
@@ 8
This spell creates a minor, normal trap (constructed magically). The trap can
deliver up to a 'B' critical strike (must be either a Slash, a Krush, or a
Puncture; specified by the caster at the time of casting) to any one target.
The size of the trap can vary from 1' radius to 10' radius. The time to
construct the trap is 1 round per 1' radius.
@@ 9
Gives caster a 95% chance of predicting time, type, and severity of weather
over next 24 hour period.
@@ 10
Caster can monitor animate activity in the area (e.g., he will be aware of
subtle movements). For the duration of this spell, the caster cannot move.
@@ 11
As Water Finding I, except range is 10 miles.
@@ 12
Allows caster to set up a natural “alarm system” in the area of effect. Any
disturbing activity will cause caster to be alerted.
@@ 13
As Food Finding I, except range is 10 miles.
@@ 14
As Lesser Traps, except trap can deliver an 'E' critical hit.
@@ 15
As Shelter Finding I, except range is 10 miles.
@@ 16
As Nature’s Awareness I, except for the area of effect.
@@ 17
Finds the closet water source (as defined in Water Finding I). This spell
gives only direction and distance; no information about the size and quality
of the water source is gained.
@@ 18
Finds the closest source of food (as defined in Food Finding I) This spell
gives only direction and distance; no information about the quantity or
quality of the food source is gained.
@@ 19
Find the closet shelter (as defined in Shelter Finding I). This spell gives
only direction and distance; no information about the size or type of shelter
is gained.
@@ 20
As Nature’s Awareness I, except for the area of effect.
@@ 25
As Weather Prediction I, except period is 5 days.
@@ 30
As Waiting Awareness II, except that the radius is 50'.
@@ 50
As Nature’s Awareness I, except for the area of effect.
